existing_site.notes: The website on the Google listing is dead. Both goodstorysurf.com and www.goodstorysurf.com 301 to www.goodstoryvillage.com, where /surf-school returns a bare Next.js 404 ('404: This page could not be found.', 33 characters of body text). The landing site goodstoryvillage.com is a villa-rental listing with no surf-school content and only a mailto: as a booking path. A search engine still indexes goodstorysurf.com under the title 'Surf school, surf lessons, surf camp, hotel in Sri Lanka', so the loss looks recent and unnoticed.
